fields.description: Master switch. When disabled, payment proof OCR will not run automatically or manually.
fields.label: Enable Payment OCR

fields.description: Run OCR automatically when payment proofs are added or Patient Encounter is saved.
fields.label: Enable Auto OCR

fields.description: Show the manual Read Payment Proofs button and allow manual OCR API calls.
fields.label: Enable Manual OCR

fields.description: When enabled, OCR extraction uses only the credentials and keys entered below. When disabled, OCR extraction uses site_config.json.
fields.label: Use App-Level OCR Config

fields.description: Required when Use App-Level OCR Config is enabled.
fields.label: Textract Access Key ID

fields.description: Required when Use App-Level OCR Config is enabled.
fields.label: Textract Secret Access Key

fields.description: Required when Use App-Level OCR Config is enabled.
fields.label: Textract Region

fields.description: Optional. Enables OpenAI cleanup when normal OCR parsing cannot extract enough payment details.
fields.label: OpenAI API Key

fields.description: When Use App-Level OCR Config is disabled, the app uses payment_ocr_openai_model from site_config.json, or this default if not set.
fields.label: OpenAI Model

fields.description: Match OCR results with gateway transactions when gateway data is available.
fields.label: Enable Gateway Verification

fields.description: When enabled, match gateway transactions without OCR reference number. Uses amount, timestamp, payer, and payment app when available; receiver-side proofs can match by exact amount and exact timestamp only when one gateway candidate exists.
fields.label: Enable Partial Gateway Match

fields.description: When enabled, gateway verification webhook requests use only the secret entered below. When disabled, webhook requests use payment_ocr_gateway_webhook_secret from site_config.json.
fields.label: Use App-Level Gateway Config

fields.description: Required for n8n/Chrome extension webhook requests when Use App-Level Gateway Config is enabled. Send as X-Payment-OCR-Token.
fields.label: Gateway Webhook Secret
